source_comparison.inspection: Archived source bytes verified against manifests. Changes register/route core ablation models and historical Instacart contract/recovery validators; common training, head/loss and encoder implementation file hashes remain equal.

limitations: Not parameter/FLOP matched across encoder families
Shared fixed learning rate rather than equal-budget model-specific hyperparameter tuning
Same seed does not imply identical tensors across distinct architectures
Variable early stopping produces different optimizer steps and elapsed time
Models use shared heads/loss, not unmodified original-paper end-to-end systems
Titan plus history MLP is a composite model; a win does not isolate Titan from the added MLP
Instacart history MLP seed62 is incomplete; no complete 3-seed MLP result is reported
Post-hoc validation comparison; no held-out evaluation or new training performed
